name: THE CONTEXT
spoken: See, 100 rupees a day is only 3000 rupees a month.

name: THE INSIGHT
spoken: And parked in a bank account, that's nothing. But invested? That 3000 rupees starts working.

name: 10 YEARS
spoken: At 12 percent a year, 10 years becomes 7 lakh rupees.

name: 20 YEARS
spoken: 20 years? 30 lakh rupees. Still no salary raise. Just the same coin, every day.

name: THE PAYOFF
spoken: 30 years? One crore. The coin did the work. You just didn't spend it.

name: THE CALLBACK + CTA
spoken: So no, 100 rupees won't change your life today. But 30 years of it? One crore. Follow for more money lessons in 30 seconds.
